title: Daily Score Model Input Coverage
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(input_complete="true")) as successful by _time input_domain
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for daily score model inputs by input domain.
value: Input coverage is the fastest way to know whether a daily score is trustworthy before you react to it.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for daily score model inputs events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for daily score model inputs by input domain.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how often daily score model inputs works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
